# Ars Technica

> > Ars Technica is a technology publication covering AI, security, science, gaming, and culture with in-depth analysis, reviews, and breaking news for technologists since 1998.

Ars Technica serves as a comprehensive technology news and analysis platform, offering coverage across artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, space exploration, consumer gadgets, gaming, and tech policy. The site combines breaking news, investigative reporting, and expert reviews with a focus on serving informed technology enthusiasts and professionals.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence
- Cybersecurity & Vulnerabilities
- Space Industry & Rockets
- Gaming & Hardware
- Consumer Tech & Smartphones
- Tech Policy & Regulation
- Science & Climate
- SpaceX
- Malware & Supply Chain Attacks
- Cloud & IT Infrastructure
- Automotive & EVs
- Features & In-Depth Analysis
- Product Reviews
- Breaking News
- Technology Culture

## Core Sections

- [Ars Technica Homepage](https://arstechnica.com): Homepage featuring tech news, reviews, and analysis across AI, security, gaming, and science.
- [Features & In-Depth Analysis](https://arstechnica.com/features): Featured articles on tech products, gadgets, gaming, and space exploration.
- [Reviews](https://arstechnica.com/reviews): Hardware and product reviews covering smartphones, gadgets, and consumer tech.

## Technology & AI

- [AI News & Analysis](https://arstechnica.com/ai): AI news and analysis covering generative AI, ethics, policy, safety, and products.
- [Business & IT](https://arstechnica.com/information-technology): IT and business news covering cybersecurity, vulnerabilities, cloud, and breaches.
- [Security & Cryptography](https://arstechnica.com/security): Security coverage of vulnerabilities, malware, iPhone/Android, and cryptography.
- [Tech Products & Gadgets](https://arstechnica.com/gadgets): Tech product news and reviews covering Windows, smartphones, gaming, and VR.

## Science & Space

- [Space Industry News](https://arstechnica.com/space): Space industry news covering launches, rockets, military contracts, and warfare.
- [Science & Climate](https://arstechnica.com/science): Science news covering space, rockets, Mars, NASA, SpaceX, and climate.
- [SpaceX Wins Military Contract from ULA](https://arstechnica.com/space/2026/03/spacex-swipes-yet-another-military-contract-from-united-launch-alliance): Space news on SpaceX military contract win amid ULA Vulcan rocket delays.

## Gaming & Consumer Tech

- [Gaming News & Reviews](https://arstechnica.com/gaming): Gaming news covering hardware, reviews, AI, console, and PC gaming.
- [Automotive & EVs](https://arstechnica.com/cars): Automotive news and reviews covering Tesla, BMW, EVs, and racing.

## Policy & Culture

- [Tech Policy & Regulation](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy): Tech policy coverage of regulation, FCC rulings, privacy, AI, and antitrust.
- [Culture & Entertainment](https://arstechnica.com/culture): Culture coverage including movie reviews, entertainment, and pop culture.
- [Project Hail Mary Linguistics Analysis](https://arstechnica.com/culture/2026/03/project-hail-mary-is-in-theaters-but-do-the-linguistics-work): Film review analyzing linguistic accuracy in Project Hail Mary movie.

## Health & Science

- [Health News](https://arstechnica.com/health): Health news covering vaccines, disease outbreaks, CDC policy, and public health.
- [JC Virus and Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy](https://arstechnica.com/health/2026/03/youre-likely-already-infected-with-a-brain-eating-virus-youve-never-heard-of): Health article on JC virus infection and PML disease in immune-suppressed patients.

## Membership & Subscriptions

- [Subscribe to Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/subscribe): Subscription page for Ars Pro and Ars Pro++ membership tiers with features.
- [Subscription Plans](https://arstechnica.com/store/product/subscriptions): Subscription pricing page for Ars Pro and Ars Pro++ membership plans.
